entry.name: jit.plume
entry.description: jit.plume takes two input matrices and uses an average value of all planes for each cell in a second input (control) matrix to displace the corresponding cell of the first (input) matrix.

messages.name: planeselect
messages.digest: Select planes to average for offset in the input matrix
messages.description: Chooses which planes on the second matrix (inlet 2) are averaged to offset the first matrix. Themessage takes the following arguments:-2 = Average all planes-1 = Average all planes except plane 0 (default)0-x = A singleargument specifies a single plane (no average)A list ofarguments specifies a multiplane average of the planes listed (e.g., 0 2 3)
